AdminProfile.title: AdminProfile
AdminProfile.description: Represents an authorized administrator of Friendship Zone (2005), Kalir Bazar.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

adminCodeHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the verified committee master PIN.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MemberAccount.title: MemberAccount
MemberAccount.description: Represents a member profile and cooperative savings account with AES-256-GCM encrypted PII fields.

memberId.description: Unique human-readable Member ID assigned by admin (e.g., FZ-2005-001).

encryptedName.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted full name of the member.

encryptedAddress.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted residential address of the member.

encryptedMobile.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted mobile number of the member.

encryptedNid.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted National ID (NID) number of the member.

encryptedNomineeName.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted full name of the member's nominee.

encryptedNomineeAddress.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted residential address of the nominee.

encryptedNomineeNid.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted National ID (NID) number of the nominee.

pinHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the member's login PIN.

mobileLookupHash.description: SHA-256 blind index hash of the normalized mobile number.

memberIdLookupHash.description: SHA-256 blind index hash of the normalized Member ID.

lastBindProof.description: Cryptographic proof string (uid:pinHash) used when binding a new device.

totalDeposited.description: Total cumulative deposited amount in BDT.

totalWithdrawn.description: Total cumulative withdrawn amount in BDT.

authorizedUids.description: Bounded list (max 10) of Firebase Auth UIDs authorized to view this member account.

transactionIds.description: Bounded list (max 100) of transaction document IDs associated with this member.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who created this member profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MemberBinding.title: MemberBinding
MemberBinding.description: Non-PII capability lookup index mapping SHA256(identifier + pinHash) to a memberDocId for multi-device login.

memberDocId.description: Target document ID in the members collection.

createdByUid.description: UID of the user who created this binding record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the binding was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the binding was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

TransactionRecord.title: TransactionRecord
TransactionRecord.description: Represents a financial deposit or withdrawal transaction for a member with AES-256-GCM encrypted notes.

memberDocId.description: Document ID of the member in the members collection.

monthYear.description: Accounting month and year in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2026-11).

encryptedNote.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted transaction remarks or receipt details.

receiptNumber.description: Official cooperative receipt or voucher reference number.

authorizedUids.description: Bounded list (max 10) of Firebase Auth UIDs authorized to view this transaction.

createdByUid.description: UID of the admin who recorded the transaction.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the transaction was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Collection of verified administrators for Friendship Zone (2005), Kalir Bazar.

/members/{memberDocId}.description: Collection of encrypted member profiles and savings balances.

/member_bindings/{bindingHash}.description: Non-PII capability hash index for multi-device Member ID/Mobile + PIN login.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Collection of member deposit and withdrawal transactions.
